ui.providers.phone.account.note: {identity} is the backend-masked label; {id} is the credential number the setup is bound to.

ui.providers.phone.account_unlabeled.role: account line when the backend sends no identity label
ui.providers.phone.account_unlabeled.note: Fallback only; the UI never builds its own mask. {id} is the credential number.

ui.providers.phone.action.activate.note: {amount} is the exact fresh amount; pressing it accepts exactly that price.

ui.providers.phone.action.cancel.note: Cancels the in-flight browser sign-in through the existing sign-in hook.

ui.providers.phone.action.check_again.note: Runs a fresh read-only check; never mutates.

ui.providers.phone.action.choose.note: {identity} is backend-masked; never build a mask in the UI.

ui.providers.phone.action.choose_unlabel.role: button per account when no identity label exists
ui.providers.phone.action.choose_unlabel.note: Fallback for a missing backend label.

ui.providers.phone.action.copy_address.note: Copies the verified address through the shared copy button.

ui.providers.phone.action.set_up.note: Shown only when no activation is required; sends a run for the selected account.

ui.providers.phone.action.sign_in.tone: matches the existing provider sign-in button
ui.providers.phone.action.sign_in.note: Starts the existing browser sign-in; human provider consent happens in the browser.

ui.providers.phone.address_label.note: The exact URL the backend verified, never a guessed or cached one.

ui.providers.phone.choose_heading.note: Several accounts exist; the app never picks one.

ui.providers.phone.consent.role: consent sentence beside the activate button
ui.providers.phone.consent.note: UI-owned: the backend sends this sentence only in its terminal rendering. Wording mirrors local-operator mobile.setup.consent. Must keep: this account, the amount, no credit purchase.

ui.providers.phone.failure.check.note: Used for a 5xx, a non-JSON body or an unreadable answer on a READ; safe to say nothing changed.

ui.providers.phone.failure.run.note: Used when a run's outcome is unknown; never claims rollback or success.

ui.providers.phone.heading.note: Names the Radient-hosted phone tunnel; sits above every state.

ui.providers.phone.price.note: {amount} is the backend's fresh monthly amount, unformatted, so it equals what is sent back for acceptance.

ui.providers.phone.receipts_heading.note: Introduces backend-written receipts of steps that already happened.

ui.providers.phone.signing_in.role: status while the existing browser sign-in runs
ui.providers.phone.signing_in.note: Human provider consent happens in the browser tab the existing sign-in opens; this block opens no tab of its own.

ui.providers.phone.status.applying.note: A setup run is live on the backend; nothing the user must do.

ui.providers.phone.status.checking.note: Read-only check in progress; nothing is being changed.

ui.providers.phone.status.connected.note: Shown ONLY when the backend reports verified true; never for waiting or cached state.
